review_text: Pick Up Coffee has always been me and my buddy’s go-to for comfort drinks. For me, it’s the white chocolate matcha 🍵and white mocha latte☕️, while my buddy loves their refreshing fruit teas and white chocolate Matcha🍵. Before, we had to travel all the way to Lanang just to enjoy them. Now, with the Oroderm branch in Claveria, it’s so much easier to drop by after office hours and sip our favorites together. The café is cozy and welcoming, but what makes it truly special is the staff. They are consistently accommodating, and the manager always goes above and beyond. One time, we had a payment issue because of a network problem with the swipe machine and even their QR option couldn’t process the payment. The manager kindly offered to let us send the payment to her GCash so she could hand us cash in return, since we didn’t have any on hand that time after coming straight from the office. That simple act of kindness really moved me and my buddy it showed genuine care and hospitality. Since then, this branch has become our regular spot. Every visit feels more than just grabbing coffee☕️ 🍵it’s about enjoying great drinks, reliable service, and the warmth of people who genuinely care. Thank you, Pick-Up Coffee - Oroderm Branch for making our coffee moments special.🫶🏻
